about.description: Single-stock perpetual on Entropy, the HIP-3 builder-deployed dex 'io' on Hyperliquid, tracking SanDisk Corp. (SNDK) and cash-settled in USDC. Real share-price units - marks in line with the same underlying on other HIP-3 venues (io:SNDK 1523.9 vs xyz:SNDK 1523.6 at time of listing). Oracle uses the primary listing venue's price during regular session and a depth-gated blend of an order-book EMA with the last session tick (or an approved after-hours venue mid) outside it. 10x max leverage, isolated margin, $5M open-interest cap.
